page_summary: This page presents the survey design and sample characteristics for a global study on cybersecurity in ports, conducted between November and December 2025. It includes a breakdown of survey respondents by income level, highlighting the distribution across high-income, upper-middle-income, lower-middle-income, and low-income categories. The survey aimed to capture a comprehensive view of cybersecurity practices and challenges faced by various organizations in the port sector.
